## Planned chapters

::: {.callout-note}
Series outline. Full chapters and controlled comparisons will be added during week three.
:::

1. Post-training map and supervised fine-tuning
2. Preference data and reward modeling
3. RLHF and PPO from first principles
4. DPO and direct preference-optimization families
5. Reasoning RL and GRPO
6. Evaluation, safety, red-teaming, model cards, and research proposals

The central artifact is one controlled comparison: the same base model and evaluation set across base, SFT, DPO, PPO, and GRPO checkpoints.
